title: Cannibalism Super ultra mega
description: This mod adds my favorite cannibalism, which I adore. In this mod, you can craft a special knife to use when you chop up villagers or other players, and they'll drop meat.
body:
The Cannibalism Super Ultra Mega mod introduces a new gameplay mechanic: cannibalism.
You can craft a new item from a stick and iron—a cannibal knife.

![Knife](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ff4e6c5f15482069e340984c68aa65e0e40c706.png)

If you hit villagers or players with this knife, they will drop various organs: liver, heart, legs, arms, etc.

![Heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/353d6b0fdc98085396b736942f56bb697f2e8e97.png)
![leg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8f570afa008fb7bcab9ad728ed7bbf7c4a2f978.png)
![ribs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/631e498c0dbca10ba05ac5fababa9fc351fa9316.png)
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2963a0d25e44a2b0c8be2986db68ff6cbdd00105.png)
![Liver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be29434f33496e4b6c0c656e473af51937408254.png)


The first few times you eat human flesh, you'll feel sick and nauseous.
But gradually you'll get used to it. Eventually, you'll become addicted to eating regular food. You'll die, and human flesh will give you various buffs.
But don't relax because there is one thing - the curse of the wendigo.
Have a fun game
